# viettelcloud_fs_filesystem (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud File Storage filesystem.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelcloud_subnet" "fs_subnet" {
  name = "my-subnet"
}

resource "viettelcloud_fs_filesystem" "example" {
  name     = "example-filesystem"
  size     = 100
  protocol = "NFS"

  filesystem_type = {
    name      = "Standard NFS"
    zone_name = "zone-a"
  }

  subnet = {
    id = data.viettelcloud_subnet.fs_subnet.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the filesystem. Must be between 1 and 100 characters.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional filesystem description. Omitting it preserves the backend value; set it to an empty string to clear it.
- `filesystem_type` (Attributes) Filesystem type selector. Required unless snapshot is set, and must not be set with snapshot at creation. Supply at least one criterion. The provider selects exactly one enabled type matching all criteria. Changing the resolved ID replaces the filesystem. Omitting it keeps the current type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filesystem_type))
- `protocol` (String) Filesystem protocol. One of NFS or SMB. Required unless snapshot is set, and must not be set with snapshot at creation. Changing the configured value replaces the filesystem. Omitting it keeps the current protocol.
- `size` (Number) Filesystem size in GiB. Required unless snapshot is set, and must not be set with snapshot at creation; a filesystem created from a snapshot takes its size from the backend. Can only be increased after creation. Omitting it keeps the current size.
- `snapshot` (Attributes) Source snapshot to create the filesystem from. Set it instead of size, protocol, filesystem_type, and subnet; the backend takes those from the snapshot. Changing it replaces the filesystem. The provider reads the source snapshot that the backend reports, so an import records it. Omitting it keeps the recorded value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshot))
- `subnet` (Attributes) Subnet where the filesystem is created. Required unless snapshot is set, and must not be set with snapshot at creation. Changing the configured ID replaces the filesystem. Omitting it keeps the current subnet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnet))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the filesystem was created (RFC3339).
- `has_snapshot` (Boolean) Whether the filesystem has at least one snapshot.
- `id` (String) Filesystem ID (UUID).
- `migration_percentage` (Number) Migration progress percentage. Null when not migrating.
- `mount_target_address` (String) Mount target IP address, available after the filesystem is created.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner ID (UUID).
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID) owning the filesystem.
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID) where the filesystem resides.
- `region_name` (String) Region name where the filesystem resides.
- `snapshot_policy` (Attributes) Applied snapshot policy. Null when no policy is applied. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshot_policy))
- `status` (String) Current filesystem status.
- `subnet_cidr` (String) CIDR of the subnet.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the filesystem was last updated (RFC3339).
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID (UUID) of the subnet.
- `vpc_name` (String) VPC name of the subnet.
- `zone_id` (String) Zone ID (UUID) where the filesystem resides.
- `zone_name` (String) Zone name where the filesystem resides.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import viettelcloud_fs_filesystem.example <filesystem-uuid>
```
